title: Bring a machine into the fleet

captures.name: access
captures.title: Start here: enroll a machine
captures.body: Access lists everyone and everything that can act on this instance. Until a machine has enrolled, this card is the only thing here that matters.

captures.name: command
captures.title: What this command does
captures.body: It points the daemon at this server and registers the machine under your user. Swap the token placeholder for one of your own keys — that token is what ties the machine to you.

captures.name: enroll
captures.title: Waiting for the machine to report in
captures.body: The guide moves on by itself the moment the machine checks in. If you would rather finish setting it up later, leave this step and come back — nothing is lost.

captures.name: user
captures.title: Open your own user
captures.body: Everything attached to an identity is here: the keys it signs in with, the machines it enrolled, its tokens and its AI accounts.

captures.name: machines
captures.title: The machines that answered
captures.body: The machine you just enrolled is listed here with its heartbeat. Online means it can host a session right now.
